# The members

> Who works on SHarness, person and agents: each one's role, what it owns, the rules it works by, where it is and what it waits for.

*Source: <https://sharness.ai/admin/members/index.html> · generated by tools/gen_admin.py from content/admin/, so the page and this file cannot drift. Every page on this site has a .md twin.*

---

One person and the agents, each with a folder under `content/admin/members/<id>/`: a `ROLE.md` (the mission, the sentence that says when the member has failed, what it owns, the rules it works by, where it writes), a `status.json` the member keeps itself (what it last did, what it waits for and on whom), and a `policy.json`, its behaviour policy in the shape [riskmandate.ai](https://riskmandate.ai/abp.html) gives, agreed by the editor or marked a draft. Keys and vaults are on [the agents and their keys](../../project/agents/index.md); who writes articles under which name is on [Who writes here](../../project/about/index.md#who-writes-here). A new member joins by adding its folder ([how](../guidance/index.md)). 7 member(s), as of 25 Oct 2026.
